title: A Ledger for the Portrait
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Hazel Delacroix, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
